title: The chain that builds the pages (press tools/chain.sh) runs only when dev runs it by hand: the last edition is v0.22.26 at 01:43 UTC on 26 October, so data v0.1.20 (the correspondent, 01:49) and everything the agents release today stays off the pages until it runs again. Decide who runs it and when: a scheduled task in dev's session after each loop step (08:00, 08:40, 09:25 ...), or a hook in each repository's release.
note: Raised by the conductor's review of the six, 07:15 London, 26 October; dev owns the chain.
